description: STAGE-CONSISTENCY BASELINE for saga #811 (issue #816 item 5): the `check()` half of a pair whose `-execute` sibling is a CHARACTERIZATION fixture. This half is ALREADY CORRECT today and is expected to survive the fix UNCHANGED — it is precisely the answer the run path never consults, which is the whole of saga #811's shape-A mechanism. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. Saga #811's first reproduction, `print (difference 10 5)`: `difference` is a classic-Logo spelling OpenLogo does not define in any profile — measured `ol-unknown-command` under the studio's full nine-profile set too, not only under Core.
